data.long_meaning: Netai is a Sanskrit name that means 'Lord of the mind'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Netra', which means 'eye' or 'God of vision'. Netai is a name that signifies wisdom, intelligence, and the ability to see beyond the ordinary. The name Netai carries the meaning “Lord of the mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Netai usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
